title: Orbital Research
purpose: Prove sustained station operation through experiments and produce the archive that gates Moon access.
optimization_opportunities: Right-size eclipse storage, keep experiments powered, transmit data automatically, and use orbital energy productively.
infrastructure_reuse: The same station, solar array, docking, and Research Station support Moon logistics and later Mars traffic.

milestones.title: Orbital Experiment Program
final_validation: Complete vacuum materials, radiation, telescope, microgravity, life-support, communications, and eclipse experiments as implemented.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check representative experiments until modules record them.

milestones.title: Orbital Operational Data
final_validation: Record station, oxygen, power, solar, eclipse, manufacturing, and transmission uptime.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the operating run until telemetry persists automatically.

milestones.title: Orbital Solar Industry
final_validation: Run an automated orbital production line from enhanced orbital solar generation.

milestones.title: Advanced Tracking Solar Array
final_validation: Build an advanced tracking array targeting 15–25× Earth solar output when implemented.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the planned array; final output scaling is not implemented.

milestones.title: Orbital Research Archive
final_validation: Demonstrate the capability: Orbital Research Archive.
milestones.temporary_validation: Obtain the test archive. Final validation requires powered research, experiments, sustained environment, eclipse survival, and telemetry transmission.

milestones.title: Moon Access
final_validation: Use the Orbital Research Archive to authorize lunar navigation, descent, and environmental systems.
milestones.temporary_validation: The quest dependency is authoritative; destination-level runtime enforcement remains future work.
